description: This file defines denormalization services for a version control repository analysis system. It includes structures and methods for denormalizing data into various database views related to commits, tech areas, and project changes over time.

classes.name: GlobalDenormalizer
classes.description: Handles denormalization across the entire dataset, such as top committers and tech areas.

classes.name: ScopedDenormalizer
classes.description: Handles denormalization within a specific scope, such as recent views and changes over time for particular diff targets.

methods.name: DenormalizeToTopCommitter
methods.description: Populates the 'top committer' denormalized view in the database.

methods.name: DenormalizeToTopTechArea
methods.description: Populates the 'top tech area' denormalized view.

methods.name: DenormalizeToRecentView
methods.description: Stores recent project diff data into a denormalized view.

methods.name: DenormalizeToChangesOverTime
methods.description: Stores grouped changes over time into a denormalized view.

methods.name: DenormalizeToRecentCommits
methods.description: Stores recent commit data into a denormalized view.
